definitions.outcome: UP if window return > +t%, DOWN if < -t%, else NEUTRAL (t = outcome threshold).
definitions.evaluationSample: Greedy chronological non-overlapping windows; every model and baseline is scored on exactly the same windows and labels.
definitions.handSet: Production scoring formula; verdict threshold (±score) chosen on training rows by balanced accuracy.
definitions.logistic: Experimental multinomial L2 logistic regression on raw replay features; scaling/imputation/penalty fitted on training rows (penalty via an inner purged chronological split).
definitions.majority: Always predicts the most frequent class in the training rows.
definitions.momentum: Predicts the sign of the previous window return when it exceeds ±t%, else NEUTRAL.
definitions.empirical: Training-period class frequencies (Laplace-smoothed) for every window.
definitions.scoreCalibrated: Score-bin class frequencies fitted on non-overlapping training windows.
definitions.brier: Standard multiclass Brier score: mean of the sum over 3 classes of (p - y)^2; range 0-2, lower is better; uniform forecast = 0.6667.
definitions.logLoss: Mean negative natural log of the probability given to the realised class; uniform = ln 3 = 1.0986.
definitions.skill: Skill = 1 - score / empirical-baseline score; > 0 means better than the training class frequencies.
definitions.macroF1: Unweighted mean of per-class F1 over classes that occur.
definitions.intervals: Seeded percentile bootstrap (resampling non-overlapping test windows); paired differences reuse identical resamples.

selection.rule: Outcome threshold with the highest mean (over walk-forward development folds) hand-set macro-F1 lift over the best classification baseline. A model is called persistently better only if its mean lift > 0 and it beats the best baseline in at least 75% of folds.

trading.rules: One decision per non-overlapping window; BULLISH long, BEARISH short, NEUTRAL flat; entry at decision close, exit at target close; 100% equity, compounded; flat round-trip cost.

limitations: Replays BTC/ETH/basket hourly candles and the daily Fear & Greed index only; news, spreads, derivatives and market cap have no stored history and are missing (as when a live provider fails).
24h changes come from hourly closes (the live ticker uses a rolling 24h window).
Fear & Greed is used from one hour after its 00:00 UTC stamp because its publication time is undocumented.
Trading: entry at the decision close (no latency), flat 0.20% round-trip cost assumed for spot taker fees plus slippage; no funding or market impact.
Single asset, single horizon (6 h); results do not generalise to other horizons without re-running.
